tests.instructions: One assessment per chapter grouping plus a final exam. Every question maps to the section shown in brackets so you can revise precisely.

questions.q: Which concept makes Playgrounds behave that way? (Swift ch.1)
The worked sample prints "Hello, Swift". Which statement caused it? (ch.1)
Which concept makes let behave that way? (Swift ch.2)
The worked sample prints "Optional(6) becomes 6 via ?? → 6". Which statement caused it? (ch.2)
Which concept makes func behave that way? (Swift ch.3)
The worked sample prints "[10.5, 21.0]". Which statement caused it? (ch.3)
Which concept makes protocol behave that way? (Swift ch.4)
The worked sample prints "Any Double now has .discounted()". Which statement caused it? (ch.4)
Which concept makes async behave that way? (Swift ch.5)
The worked sample prints "Result available after suspension". Which statement caused it? (ch.5)
Which concept makes View behave that way? (Swift ch.6)
The worked sample prints "A text row rendered inside a view hierarchy". Which statement caused it? (ch.6)
